entities.name: Non-3GPP NW provided policies
entities.description: Information element that indicates whether emergency numbers provided via non-3GPP access can be used to initiate UE detected emergency calls.

entities.name: Network needs to indicate emergency number usage
entities.description: Condition when the network needs to indicate whether emergency numbers provided via non-3GPP access can be used for UE detected emergency calls.

entities.name: IE not included
entities.description: Condition when the Non-3GPP NW provided policies IE is not included in the message.

entities.name: Interpret as all bits zero
entities.description: UE behavior property where absence of the IE is interpreted as receiving the IE with all bits of the value part coded as zero.

relations.description: The condition that the network needs to indicate emergency number usage determines when the IE is included.
When the IE is not included, this condition establishes the UE behavior to interpret it as all bits zero.
